authoring: AI 撰寫的學習內容；詞形參考 ECDICT。非官方試題。

entries.en: a thing that can be seen or touched

examples.en: Do not place heavy objects on the scanner.
examples.zh: 請勿將重物放在掃描器上。

entries.en: the length of time something covers

examples.en: The project has a three-year time span.
examples.zh: 這項專案的期間為三年。

entries.en: a short plan showing main points

examples.en: Send me an outline of your presentation.
examples.zh: 請寄給我你的簡報大綱。

entries.en: unusual and worthy of attention

examples.en: The team achieved remarkable growth.
examples.zh: 這個團隊取得了顯著成長。

entries.en: coming from outside an organization

examples.en: An external consultant reviewed the plan.
examples.zh: 外部顧問審查了這項計畫。

entries.en: shared by two or more parties

examples.en: The partnership is based on mutual trust.
examples.zh: 這段合作關係建立在相互信任之上。

entries.en: extremely important to a result

examples.en: Accurate scheduling is crucial to production.
examples.zh: 準確排程對生產至關重要。

entries.en: very important or needing immediate attention

examples.en: The server failure caused a critical delay.
examples.zh: 伺服器故障造成了嚴重延誤。

entries.en: meeting the conditions for something

examples.en: All full-time staff are eligible for the bonus.
examples.zh: 所有全職員工都符合獎金資格。

entries.en: working well with little waste

examples.en: The new system is more efficient.
examples.zh: 新系統更有效率。

entries.en: required by a rule or law

examples.en: Safety training is compulsory for new staff.
examples.zh: 新進員工必須接受安全訓練。

entries.en: made by people rather than occurring naturally

examples.en: The lobby uses artificial plants.
examples.zh: 大廳使用人造植物。

entries.en: existing in large numbers

examples.en: We received numerous applications.
examples.zh: 我們收到了許多申請。

entries.en: enough for a particular purpose

examples.en: The room has adequate lighting.
examples.zh: 這個房間的照明充足。

entries.en: not completed or paid by the required time

examples.en: Your payment is now overdue.
examples.zh: 你的款項已經逾期。

entries.en: unable to pay debts

examples.en: The supplier went bankrupt last year.
examples.zh: 這家供應商去年破產了。

entries.en: not working correctly because of a fault

examples.en: We will replace the defective unit.
examples.zh: 我們將更換有瑕疵的組件。

entries.en: able to be trusted to work well

examples.en: We need a reliable delivery service.
examples.zh: 我們需要可靠的配送服務。

entries.en: necessary for success or continued activity

examples.en: Communication is vital to this project.
examples.zh: 溝通對這項專案極為重要。

entries.en: involving concentrated effort over a short period

examples.en: New staff receive intensive language training.
examples.zh: 新員工接受密集語言訓練。

entries.en: able to work or exist together

examples.en: This printer is compatible with our computers.
examples.zh: 這台印表機與我們的電腦相容。

entries.en: easy to see or understand

examples.en: The cause became apparent during testing.
examples.zh: 測試期間原因變得明顯。

entries.en: enough to meet a need

examples.en: We have sufficient stock for the promotion.
examples.zh: 我們有足夠的庫存供應促銷活動。

entries.en: having a strong desire for major success

examples.en: The company set an ambitious sales target.
examples.zh: 公司設定了雄心勃勃的銷售目標。

entries.en: happening before something else

examples.en: Visitors need prior approval to enter.
examples.zh: 訪客進入前需要取得核准。

entries.en: following one after another without a break

examples.en: Sales grew for three consecutive months.
examples.zh: 銷售連續三個月成長。

entries.en: relating to manual or industrial work

examples.en: The factory offers blue-collar training programs.
examples.zh: 工廠提供藍領職業訓練課程。

entries.en: very strong or extreme

examples.en: Competition in this market is intense.
examples.zh: 這個市場的競爭非常激烈。

entries.en: causing strong disagreement

examples.en: The proposed policy is controversial.
examples.zh: 提議的政策具有爭議。

entries.en: using little money or resources

examples.en: Rail travel is an economical option.
examples.zh: 搭火車是經濟實惠的選擇。

entries.en: limited to a particular person or group

examples.en: Members receive exclusive discounts.
examples.zh: 會員享有專屬折扣。

entries.en: relating to a company

examples.en: Corporate policies apply to all branches.
examples.zh: 公司政策適用於所有分公司。

entries.en: showing strong interest or excitement

examples.en: The team is enthusiastic about the launch.
examples.zh: 團隊對新產品推出充滿熱情。

entries.en: producing a helpful effect

examples.en: The training was beneficial to new managers.
examples.zh: 這項訓練對新任經理很有幫助。

entries.en: large or important enough to matter

examples.en: The upgrade produced significant savings.
examples.zh: 這次升級節省了大量成本。

entries.en: committed to a purpose or reserved for a use

examples.en: A dedicated team handles urgent requests.
examples.zh: 有專責團隊處理緊急請求。

entries.en: not enough for a particular purpose

examples.en: The application was rejected for insufficient information.
examples.zh: 申請因資料不足遭到駁回。

entries.en: having fewer workers than needed

examples.en: The restaurant is understaffed tonight.
examples.zh: 餐廳今晚人手不足。

entries.en: remaining similar in quality or behavior

examples.en: Customers expect consistent service.
examples.zh: 顧客期待穩定的服務品質。

entries.en: required by an official rule

examples.en: Attendance at the briefing is mandatory.
examples.zh: 這場簡報會必須出席。

entries.en: clearly and exactly stated

examples.en: We need a precise delivery time.
examples.zh: 我們需要確切的配送時間。

entries.en: genuine rather than copied or false

examples.en: The restaurant serves authentic regional cuisine.
examples.zh: 餐廳供應道地的地方料理。

entries.en: correct and free from mistakes

examples.en: Please provide an accurate shipping address.
examples.zh: 請提供正確的送貨地址。

entries.en: intended to remain private

examples.en: Employee records are confidential.
examples.zh: 員工紀錄屬於機密資料。

entries.en: relating to money

examples.en: The board reviewed the financial results.
examples.zh: 董事會審查了財務成果。

entries.en: specific and definite rather than general

examples.en: We need concrete evidence before acting.
examples.zh: 採取行動前我們需要具體證據。

entries.en: able to last without damage

examples.en: These chairs are durable and easy to clean.
examples.zh: 這些椅子耐用又容易清潔。

entries.en: able to compete successfully

examples.en: We offer competitive salaries.
examples.zh: 我們提供有競爭力的薪資。

entries.en: working carefully and with effort

examples.en: Her diligent research prevented a costly mistake.
examples.zh: 她仔細的研究避免了昂貴的錯誤。

entries.en: very great in amount or degree

examples.en: The project required tremendous effort.
examples.zh: 這項專案需要極大的努力。

entries.en: worried about something that may happen

examples.en: Staff felt apprehensive about the relocation.
examples.zh: 員工對搬遷感到憂慮。

entries.en: equal in value or meaning

examples.en: Relevant experience may be considered equivalent.
examples.zh: 相關經驗可能被視為同等資格。

entries.en: relating to sales in large quantities

examples.en: Wholesale prices are available for large orders.
examples.zh: 大量訂單可享批發價格。

entries.en: additional or more advanced

examples.en: Please contact us for further information.
examples.zh: 如需進一步資訊請聯絡我們。

entries.en: mainly or for the most part

examples.en: The service is primarily for small businesses.
examples.zh: 這項服務主要供小型企業使用。

entries.en: at the place where work happens

examples.en: Technicians will provide support onsite.
examples.zh: 技術人員將在現場提供支援。

entries.en: to make an exact copy

examples.en: Do not duplicate the confidential files.
examples.zh: 請勿複製機密檔案。

entries.en: to obtain something or buy a business

examples.en: We acquired new equipment last month.
examples.zh: 我們上個月添購了新設備。

entries.en: to examine possible options

examples.en: The team will explore alternative suppliers.
examples.zh: 團隊將尋找其他可能的供應商。

entries.en: to meet the requirements for something

examples.en: You may qualify for a travel allowance.
examples.zh: 你可能符合差旅津貼資格。

entries.en: to become visible or known

examples.en: New opportunities emerged after the merger.
examples.zh: 合併後出現了新的機會。

entries.en: to focus on a particular field

examples.en: Our firm specializes in commercial design.
examples.zh: 我們公司專精於商業設計。

entries.en: to start or set up something

examples.en: We established a branch in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 我們在高雄設立了分公司。

entries.en: to communicate a message or transport something

examples.en: The brochure conveys our brand values.
examples.zh: 這本手冊傳達了我們的品牌價值。

entries.en: to find people to join an organization

examples.en: We are recruiting experienced engineers.
examples.zh: 我們正在招募有經驗的工程師。

entries.en: to keep something or someone

examples.en: Flexible hours help retain skilled staff.
examples.zh: 彈性工時有助於留住技術人員。

entries.en: to make something stronger

examples.en: The training reinforces good safety habits.
examples.zh: 這項訓練能加強良好的安全習慣。

entries.en: to use energy or materials

examples.en: The new machine consumes less electricity.
examples.zh: 新機器耗電較少。

entries.en: to produce something

examples.en: The campaign generated many inquiries.
examples.zh: 這次活動帶來了許多詢問。

entries.en: to oversee work or workers

examples.en: She supervises the evening shift.
examples.zh: 她負責監督晚班。

entries.en: to limit access or activity

examples.en: The policy restricts access to customer records.
examples.zh: 政策限制對顧客紀錄的存取。

entries.en: to make something easier to understand

examples.en: Please clarify the payment terms.
examples.zh: 請釐清付款條件。

entries.en: to continue after a pause or decision

examples.en: We can proceed once approval arrives.
examples.zh: 獲得核准後我們就能繼續進行。

entries.en: to formally leave a job

examples.en: He resigned from the company last month.
examples.zh: 他上個月辭去了公司職務。

entries.en: to give something for a loss or work

examples.en: We compensated customers for the service outage.
examples.zh: 我們補償了因服務中斷受影響的顧客。

entries.en: to carry out a promise or meet a need

examples.en: The supplier fulfilled every contract requirement.
examples.zh: 供應商履行了所有合約要求。

entries.en: to put a plan into action

examples.en: We will implement the policy next month.
examples.zh: 我們將在下個月實施這項政策。

entries.en: to remove someone from a job or reject an idea

examples.en: The manager dismissed the suggestion as impractical.
examples.zh: 經理認為這項建議不可行而不予採納。

entries.en: to find an answer to a problem

examples.en: We resolved the billing issue yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天解決了帳單問題。

entries.en: to judge quality or effectiveness

examples.en: The panel will evaluate each proposal.
examples.zh: 評審小組將評估每份提案。

entries.en: to state details clearly

examples.en: Please specify your preferred delivery time.
examples.zh: 請明確指定你偏好的配送時間。

entries.en: to work together toward a goal

examples.en: Designers collaborate with the marketing team.
examples.zh: 設計師與行銷團隊合作。

entries.en: to examine information carefully

examples.en: We analyze customer feedback every week.
examples.zh: 我們每週分析顧客回饋。

entries.en: to stop something temporarily

examples.en: The service was suspended for maintenance.
examples.zh: 這項服務因維護而暫停。

entries.en: to give a good reason for something

examples.en: The savings justify the initial investment.
examples.zh: 節省的成本足以證明初期投資合理。

entries.en: to discover something not easily noticed

examples.en: The system detected an unusual transaction.
examples.zh: 系統偵測到一筆異常交易。

entries.en: to repair and improve a building

examples.en: We plan to renovate the reception area.
examples.zh: 我們計畫整修接待區。

entries.en: to make something previously unknown clear

examples.en: The survey revealed a need for better training.
examples.zh: 調查顯示需要更好的訓練。

entries.en: to return something to a previous condition

examples.en: Technicians restored the network connection.
examples.zh: 技術人員恢復了網路連線。

entries.en: to fail to notice something

examples.en: We overlooked an important contract detail.
examples.zh: 我們忽略了一項重要合約細節。

entries.en: to change something greatly

examples.en: The renovation transformed the old warehouse.
examples.zh: 整修讓舊倉庫煥然一新。

entries.en: to subtract an amount

examples.en: The fee will be deducted from your refund.
examples.zh: 這筆費用將從退款中扣除。

entries.en: to show or represent something

examples.en: The figures reflect stronger customer demand.
examples.zh: 這些數字反映了更強勁的顧客需求。

entries.en: to exchange a voucher or points for something

examples.en: You can redeem points for a discount.
examples.zh: 你可以用點數兌換折扣。

entries.en: to check that something is valid

examples.en: Please validate your parking ticket at reception.
examples.zh: 請在接待處驗證停車票。

entries.en: to accept responsibility or carry a cost

examples.en: The supplier will bear the shipping costs.
examples.zh: 供應商將負擔運費。

entries.en: to make something accessible or unprotected

examples.en: The leak exposed confidential customer information.
examples.zh: 資料外洩暴露了機密顧客資訊。

entries.en: to establish a fact or decide a result

examples.en: The inspection will determine the repair cost.
examples.zh: 檢查將確定維修費用。

entries.en: to start a company or organization

examples.en: They founded the company in 2015.
examples.zh: 他們在二〇一五年創立了公司。

entries.en: to make sure a rule is obeyed

examples.en: Security staff enforce the parking rules.
examples.zh: 保全人員負責執行停車規定。
